data.creative: Plantar wart armor explainer: why OTC fails, then the softening oil · 1864910957451503
data.hook: Why won't over-the-counter treatments work on plantar warts?
data.desire: Get rid of the painful plantar wart that keeps coming back, without burning or freezing it
data.angle: Your past treatments failed because the wart sits under a layer of hard skin that blocks them
data.belief_shift: from 'I just need a stronger freeze or acid' → to 'surface treatments can't reach it; I need something that softens the thick skin layer by layer'
data.script_structure: question hook → brand authority line (a decade helping people) → hidden cause: thick skin acts like armor → why burn/freeze/scrape fail and warts return → third-party lab, plant-based formula → what happens when you apply it (soften, dry, shrink, flake) → twice-a-day routine and weeks timeline → 90-day guarantee → CTA
data.mechanism_reveal: Claim: plantar warts grow under 'armor' of compacted skin; the oils soften that skin so it 'renews itself layer by layer', and the area dries, shrinks and flakes. Shown with 3D skin-layer animations.
data.proof: Claimed decade of experience with a white-coat presenter holding the bottle (0:08); 'third-party lab' with lab footage and a 'Third Party Tested' badge (0:35); smiling kids and adults holding the bottle (1:09-1:16); 90-day money-back guarantee card (1:29); foot close-ups described as flattening (1:19-1:33)
data.cta: Click below to try H-Warts Formula today; fast shipping, 90-day money-back guarantee, 'zero risk'
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: It opens on the viewer's own failed attempt and gives a visual reason (armor of hard skin) that excuses the failure. The step-by-step 'here's what happens when you apply it' turns a vague oil into a visible process with a timeline.
data.transferable_move: Name the physical barrier that stopped every past fix, show it in a cross-section animation, then walk through what the product does step by step with a realistic timeline. Soften: talk about rough, thick skin and how it looks, not removing a condition.
data.opening_visual: Close-up of a freezing spray hitting a foot sole with frost, caption 'Why won't OTC treatments work on plantar warts?'
data.transition_to_product: 0:08 white-coat presenter holds the bottle with a red arrow ('We've spent over a decade helping people'); named at 0:49 'It's called H-Warts Formula'
data.proof_placement: Authority presenter follows the hook; lab/third-party footage follows the failure section; kid and user clips follow the mechanism walk-through; guarantee card sits just before the CTA
data.transcript:
Automatic transcript (en) from the original ad audio (Whisper, run locally 2026-11-10). Recognition errors may remain in names; numbers and claims are the advertiser's.
[0.0–2.5] Why won't over-the-counter treatments work on plantar warts?
[2.5–4.1] It's not that they're impossible to manage,
[4.1–7.0] it's that most treatments miss what's happening beneath the surface.
[7.0–9.9] We've spent over a decade helping people finally break free
[9.9–12.3] from the frustration of stubborn plantar warts,
[12.3–15.1] and most are shocked when they learn why nothing else worked.
[15.1–18.1] Plantar warts grow deep, underneath layers of hardened skin.
[18.1–20.4] That thick, compacted tissue acts like armor,
[20.4–23.6] blocking most surface-level treatments from reaching where the wart begins.
[23.6–25.7] You can burn, freeze, or scrape the surface,
[25.7–28.3] and the problem often just sits quietly underneath.
[28.3–30.5] That's why so many people see them come right back,
[30.5–33.5] sometimes even thicker or more uncomfortable than before.
[33.5–35.3] So we took a different path.
[35.3–37.6] We partnered with a third-party lab to create something
[37.6–40.2] that works with the skin's natural process.
[40.2–43.1] Together we developed a natural, plant-based formula
[43.1–45.6] that helps soften the thick skin covering the wart,
[45.6–49.5] so the skin can gently renew itself layer by layer over time.
[49.5–51.1] It's called H-Warts Formula,
[51.1–54.4] and it's built around some of nature's most time-tested botanicals.
[54.4–55.9] Here's what happens when you apply it.
[56.0–59.2] The oils start by loosening and softening the surface around the wart,
[59.2–62.6] helping to break down the rough, hardened skin that's been building up.
[62.6–66.0] As you keep applying it, the area begins to dry, shrink, and flake,
[66.0–69.0] naturally allowing healthy new skin to gradually appear.
[69.0–71.5] That's the quiet secret behind H-Warts Formula.
[71.5–75.1] It's gentle, easy to use, and works without acids, freezing, or pain.
[75.1–77.1] You just apply it topically, twice a day,
[77.1–80.0] and within a few weeks, many people notice their plantar wart
[80.0–82.3] starting to flatten and fade in appearance,
[82.3–85.0] leaving skin that looks smoother and feels more comfortable.
[85.1–87.9] Right now, H-Warts Formula is available with fast shipping
[87.9–90.1] and backed by a 90-day money-back guarantee,
[90.1–92.4] so there's zero risk in giving it a try.
[92.4–95.1] If you've been dealing with a persistent area of thickened skin
[95.1–98.8] caused by plantar warts, click below to try H-Warts Formula today.
[98.8–101.7] You'll be amazed how your skin responds once you let nature do the work.
